obligations.source_text: Every target-relevant garment region and every target-relevant foot region must remain fully visible, unobstructed, and visually inspectable in the single frame.

bindings.fitted_legging_legs_phrase: two fitted legging legs continue cleanly to the ankle hems
bindings.hem_to_strap_transition_phrase: each ankle hem visibly transitions into a narrow garment-owned strap
bindings.underfoot_route_phrase: each strap travels visibly beneath the arch of the foot
bindings.left_right_consistency_phrase: left and right stirrup loops remain structurally consistent and visible
bindings.sock_footed_tight_shoe_strap_confound_co: socks, footed tights, shoe straps, or leg warmers cannot substitute for the loops
